name: Deterministic LCG Noise Generation
definition: A Linear Congruential Generator (LCG) producing deterministic pseudo-random floats in the range [-1, 1) using Numerical Recipes constants. Used for procedural sound synthesis.
summary: Deterministic LCG Noise Generation is a fast, state-based pseudo-random number generator that produces normalized floats for ray origin offsetting, distinguished by its sequential arithmetic updates rather than spatial hashing.
